Name: (CP) Matching Stairs
Author: GraveDitcher
Description:
These will act like normal rugs and show up in the furniture catalogue. Due to my (extremely) limited knowledge of coding you won't be able to put these anywhere you wouldn't normally be able to place things (like the stairs outside your house for example) because I have no clue how to change that and would probably break something.

Main file contains a reference image with which stairs are intended to go with what flooring for any mod creators interested in using these stair assets.

Also worth mentioning: when looking for these in the catalogue they are named Stairs 01-101, yet for reasons unknown to me they do not show up in correct numerical order (aka you'll see something like "01, 11-19, 02, 20-29, 03" etc.) No clue why though, I guess that's just how the furniture catalogue works with numbers?

Downloads.Description: Main file also contains a reference image of all the stairs tiles with the floors they match with for mod creator uses.

Manifest.Name: (CP) Matching Stairs
Manifest.Description: Uses Content Patcher to add matching stairs tiles to the vanilla flooring options as single tile rugs.
